title: Design System: cosmic-ext-notifications

time-figures.purpose: 24-hour HH:MM at the top of the time column, each digit centred in a 12px cell and the colon in a 6px cell.

title.purpose: Notification summary, first line, one line ellipsized, paper.

body.purpose: Message preview, markup stripped, two lines ellipsized, paper dim. Weight is the theme default.

action.purpose: Action button labels, one line ellipsized.

app-label.purpose: App name under the time, one line, slate; omitted when it repeats the title. Weight is the theme default.

components.name: Banner (normal urgency)
components.description: One timetable row: fixed time column, 1px rule, then picture, title, message, dismiss and actions.
components.html:
13:51
Whatsie
Mum
Dinner at 7? Bring the dish you borrowed last week if you still have it.
components.css: .ds-banner { display: flex; width: 420px; background: #121c28; color: #f2f0ea; border-radius: 6px; overflow: hidden; font-family: Cantarell, sans-serif; } .ds-time { width: 72px; flex: none; padding: 12px 0 12px 12px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-figs { display: flex; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #f2f0ea; } .ds-figs span { width: 12px; text-align: center; } .ds-figs .ds-colon { width: 6px; } .ds-app { margin-top: 2px; font-size: 11px; color: #8c98a6; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-rule { width: 1px; flex: none; background: #2a3647; } .ds-content { flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 12px 8px 12px 12px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; } .ds-head { display: flex; gap: 4px; align-items: flex-start; } .ds-icon { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex: none; margin-right: 6px; background: #4a6b4f; } .ds-texts { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; } .ds-title { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-body { font-size: 14px; color: rgba(242,240,234,0.74); display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; } .ds-dismiss { background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px; border-radius: 4px; color: #8c98a6; display: flex; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dismiss:hover, .ds-dismiss:focus-visible { background: #2a3647; color: #f2f0ea; outline: none; } .ds-dismiss:active { background: #36455a; } .ds-actions { display: flex; gap: 4px; padding-left: 34px; } .ds-action { background: none; border: 0; padding: 4px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font: 700 14px Cantarell, sans-serif; color: #f2f0ea; cursor: pointer; } .ds-action:hover, .ds-action:focus-visible { background: #2a3647; outline: none; } .ds-action:active { background: #36455a; }

components.name: Time Column, low
components.description: Low urgency: figures dim to slate; everything else unchanged.

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Bold flat text on navy; fills lifted navy on hover, pressed navy on press.

components.name: Dismiss Button
components.description: 16px close glyph, slate at rest, paper on lifted navy when hovered.

narrative.overview:
Each banner is one row of a printed Nordic departure board: a deep navy strip with paper-white type, read left to right as when, then who, then what. A fixed-width time column on the left carries the arrival time in bold figures and the sending app beneath it; a hairline rule divides it from the content, where the sender picture or app icon sits beside a bold title and a two-line message. Because the time column sits at the same x on every banner, a stack of banners reads as a single table rather than a pile of cards.

The system is flat, dense and quiet. There is one neutral surface, two text tones and one alarm colour; urgency changes the time column only, never the content. It deliberately departs from the rounded icon-tile notification card of macOS and GNOME, which this desktop's owner rejected as generic.

The surface is a native COSMIC layer-shell banner drawn with libcosmic/iced. Tokens are Rust constants in `src/banner.rs`; type is the desktop face (Cantarell) through `cosmic::font::bold()` and the theme default.
keyCharacteristics: A 72px time column at a fixed x on every banner, so stacked banners align as one table.
Time figures set in fixed cells (12px per digit, 6px for the colon) so columns of times line up although the face's figures are proportional.
Navy strip, paper type, slate secondary, one red reserved for critical urgency.
Flat: no shadow, no border, a 6px corner and a 1px column rule.
Actions are bold text, never filled pills.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Timetable red marks critical urgency and nothing else. It never tints text, icons, buttons or borders.

rules.name: The Tier Lives In The Time Column Rule
rules.body: Urgency is shown only in the time column: low dims the figures to slate, normal sets them in paper, critical fills the column red. The content side looks the same at every tier.

rules.name: The Fixed Cell Rule
rules.body: Times are always set in fixed per-character cells, never as a free text run, so every banner's figures and colon fall on the same verticals.

rules.name: The Nothing Twice Rule
rules.body: A label that repeats the title is dropped.

rules.name: The Printed Sheet Rule
rules.body: A banner is a printed sheet: it never casts a shadow or carries an outline.

dos: **Do** keep the time column at 72px and at the same x on every banner; the stack must read as one table.
**Do** set times as 24-hour `HH:MM` in fixed cells (12px digits, 6px colon).
**Do** show urgency only in the time column: slate figures for low, paper for normal, a red fill for critical.
**Do** keep actions as bold flat text buttons (4px radius, 4px by 8px padding) that fill only on hover and press.
**Do** keep banners flat on timetable navy with a 6px corner and a 1px column rule.
donts: **Don't** use timetable red for anything except the critical time column.
**Don't** add shadows, outlines or gradients to banners.
**Don't** return to the rounded icon-tile notification card (macOS/GNOME style); it was rejected as generic.
**Don't** fill action buttons at rest or style them as pills.
**Don't** label anything twice: drop the app name when it equals the title.

notes: 2026-11-28: colours now resolve from the active COSMIC theme (see DESIGN.md colors). Hex values in this sidecar record the original fixed timetable palette and the Nord-style theme it was verified on; banner.rs no longer hardcodes them.
